artworks.title: River with Town
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Pieter Coopse
artworks.medium: etching with some roulette and burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 11 × 22 cm (4 5/16 × 8 11/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with a low vantage point looking out over the water. The horizon is low, revealing buildings and a structure that looks like a church with a spire. In the foreground, a person is in a rowboat facing left. Further back, two sailboats are anchored, and more boats can be seen in the distance. The scene is rendered in soft graphite with varying intensities to show depth and distance.

The shoreline forms a line on the horizon, and the water reflects the structures and sky.

artworks.description: The image shows a peaceful waterscape with boats and a distant village. The horizon is visible in the middle, with a skyline featuring a church and rooftops. Detailed boats with sails float on the calm water, casting reflections. A man in a small boat appears to be moving forward. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes and a color palette of soft sepia tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: River with Town
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Pieter Coopse
artworks.medium: etching and roulette with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper and hand-colored with wash
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 11 × 22 cm (4 5/16 × 8 11/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from slightly above the water level, looking across a calm body of water towards a shoreline in the distance. The horizon line is positioned in the center, separating the water from the sky. On the horizon, several buildings and a church steeple can be seen. The brushstrokes are delicate and linear, with fine lines used to depict the forms of the boats and reflections in the water. The color palette is muted and monochromatic with soft shades of gray and beige. Closest to us is a small boat with a single figure wearing a blue garment, and to the left, a couple of larger sailing boats are anchored. Both sky and water are rendered in soft washes.

artworks.title: Young Girl at the Keyboard

artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22 × 17.8 cm (8 11/16 × 7 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person seated at an angle. The individual has delicate features and curly hair held back with a ribbon. They are wearing a textured garment and holding an open book. Their fingers are resting on a keyboard instrument, and the background is plain with a border of circle and dot motifs.

artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman shown from the waist up, seated and slightly angled to the side with her head turned towards the viewer. Her features are delicately drawn, with a gentle expression and prominent eyes. Her hair is styled back with a decorative ribbon or headpiece. She wears a cloak over a dress with gathered sleeves and intricate drapery. She is holding an open book on her lap with her left hand, and her right hand is resting on it. The background is minimal, and the drawing style features soft lines and gentle shading.

The person is holding a book with musical notation, resting on a keyboard instrument, and a date "1660" is inscribed in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
artworks.medium: aquatint with some burnishing printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene from an elevated point, offering a broad view. The horizon features outlines of trees and buildings, with a church spire standing out against the clouds. The brushstrokes suggest detail, capturing structures and foliage. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving a vintage look. In the foreground, there are people, carts, barrels, and ducks. In the background, the church, buildings, and trees complete the rural scene.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
artworks.medium: aquatint with some roulette work and burnishing printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 17.4 × 28 cm (6 7/8 × 11 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned print depicting a bustling village scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, with a church spire rising into the sky. Buildings with thatched roofs and wood-plank structures are spread throughout the scene, and trees are also present. Close to the viewer, there are logs, a wooden barrel, patches of grass, and ducks swimming in a waterway. Villagers are shown engaging in various activities, such as riding horses, tending to carts, and conversing. In the distance, intricate linework is visible on the trees and buildings. The scene has a warm, monochromatic palette.

In the foreground, there are figures and wagons on a path, and in the distance, various buildings with thatched roofs are visible. The sky is depicted with soft, swirling cloud patterns, adding to the tranquil atmosphere of the scene.
